extension.displayName: SimCrux — RTL Regressions in the Test Explorer
extension.description: Turn simcrux.yaml into a VSCode test tree, run regressions as a task, keep the five SymbiYosys verdicts distinct, and open a failing proof's counterexample in a waveform tab beside it.
crux.command.sendSelectionToPeer.title: Send Selection to Crux App
crux.configuration.title: EDACrux
crux.configuration.crossProbe.revealSele: Bring the matching editor tab forward when a connected Crux app announces a selection. Keyboard focus stays where it is and the window is never raised.
crux.configuration.crossProbe.openSource: Move the cursor into the editor when a connected Crux app asks to open a source location. The window itself is never raised.
crux.command.openCapabilitiesPanel.title: Open Capabilities Panel
crux.command.toggleRtlAnnotation.title: Toggle RTL Value Annotation
crux.configuration.rtlAnnotation.enabled: Render signal values from the connected waveform as inline decorations in your Verilog/VHDL source, following the waveform cursor. Off by default; only stems-exact matches are annotated, and an ambiguous name is shown as ambiguous rather than guessed.
crux.command.simcrux.refresh.title: Refresh Regression Results
crux.command.simcrux.runRegression.title: Run Regression
crux.command.simcrux.history.title: Open This Project in SimCrux Desktop
crux.task.simcrux.config.description: Path to the simcrux.yaml this task runs. Absolute, or relative to the workspace folder. Defaults to the config resolved from `edacrux.sim.projectFile`.
crux.task.simcrux.filter.description: Substring matched against each test id (`<suite>/<name>`), passed to `simcrux --filter`. Omit to run the whole regression.
crux.configuration.sim.projectFile.descr: The SimCrux project config this window works against, relative to each workspace folder (or an absolute path). The first existing match wins, because the CLI takes one config per run and the test tree, the task and the handoff all have to agree on which.
crux.configuration.sim.resultsPath.descr: Where to read run results from. Leave empty to derive it: the config’s own `output.results_path` if it declares one, otherwise `results.ndjson` beside the config — the path `simcrux <config> --ci` writes. A relative value is resolved against the config’s directory.
crux.configuration.sim.executable.descri: The SimCrux binary the regression task runs. Resolved on PATH unless you give an absolute path.
crux.untrustedWorkspaces.description: SimCrux is disabled in a restricted workspace. Running a regression launches the simulator named by edacrux.sim.executable with a configuration taken from the workspace, and an untrusted folder must not choose what gets executed. Trust the folder to use the Test Explorer and the regression task.
crux.configuration.crossProbe.followWave: Reveal a signal's RTL declaration in the editor when you select it in a WaveCrux waveform panel in this window. Off by default: most clicks in a waveform are reading, not a request to navigate. Resolved through the stems index, so it lands only on declarations a tool wrote down; keyboard focus stays in the waveform.
